QFEP_Introduction.inherited: From Crisis_Synthesis: The crisis was never the problem. The crisis is the engine.
QFEP_Introduction.question: Can two different settings produce the same result?
QFEP_Introduction.ontology: QFEP is the project’s exploratory organising model: QFE=F−λE+φΔE. In this console the four terms are adjustable numbers, not independently measured physicalquantities.
QFEP_Introduction.experiment: Move onlyF and watch theresult. Restore it, moveE, and then try compensating withF until the numericalresult is close to whereitstarted.
QFEP_Introduction.observe: The readout and four-axis polygon change. Differentpolygon shapes can give the sameQFE; colour/category can shift as the setting approaches a different authoredsignature.
QFEP_Introduction.limit: A single aggregate number loses distinctions between its inputs. These labels are theproject’s vocabulary for exploring tension, not a calibrated biological or thermodynamiclaw.
QFEP_Introduction.variation: Existing: find two unlike knobconfigurations with a similarQFE. Proposed: let thevisitor change the definition ofΔE and record why.
QFEP_Introduction.handoff: The next room starts with a smaller, computable question: what makes an outcome easy or difficult to predict?
open_questions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.
Try the written encounter in the actual museum, alone and with a group. Check visibility, reach, the stated response and the handoff before accepting a room baseline.

QFEP_F_Term.inherited: From QFEP_Introduction: The next room starts with a smaller, computable question: what makes an outcome easy or difficult to predict?
QFEP_F_Term.question: What makes the next mark easy to predict?
QFEP_F_Term.ontology: Binaryentropy measures average uncertainty for a Bernoulli source. The room uses predictability as a concrete entry to its idea oforder; that does notidentify Shannonentropy with the project’sFterm.
QFEP_F_Term.experiment: Move thep slider nearzero, through onehalf and nearone. Predict the nexttilecolour at eachsetting; compare the curve’smarker with thesamplegrid.
QFEP_F_Term.observe: Near eitherendpoint onecolour dominates andH islow. Atp=.5 the theoreticalcurve reaches1bit perdraw, while any finitesample can stilldepart from equalcounts.
QFEP_F_Term.limit: Entropy describes a specifiedsource distribution. It is not the compressibility of everyparticular256bit picture, nor a measurement of beauty, value orfreeenergy.
QFEP_F_Term.variation: Existing: compare p=.1 withp=.9: oppositecolours but equal theoreticaluncertainty. Proposed: preserve localcorrelations while holding colourfrequency fixed to expose what a Bernoullimodel omits.
QFEP_F_Term.handoff: The entropy room next counts alternatives explicitly, asking which possibilities the model has allowed into its world.
open_questions: The workbench measures source entropy H, not model mismatch or F. Add a visible predictor and its errors while holding the source fixed.
Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.
F/freeenergy is not directlymeasured. Avoid universal finite-file compressionbound implied by legacycaption. snap_cube_puzzle registryactually resolves to octahedronpuzzle; not selectedcore.

QFEP_E_Term.inherited: From QFEP_F_Term: The entropy room next counts alternatives explicitly, asking which possibilities the model has allowed into its world.
QFEP_E_Term.question: How many endings remain possible before one is chosen?
QFEP_E_Term.ontology: A possibilitycount W describes the allowedoutcomes of a chosenmodel. For equallyweighted possibilities, logW measures their multiplicity; unequalprobabilities need a weightedentropy.
QFEP_E_Term.experiment: Watch the fan narrow to asinglepath and open into branches. Count the firstforks, predict theleafcount, then compare with the FUTURESreadout.
QFEP_E_Term.observe: The default9secondcycle changes branching between1,2and3 across4levels, giving1,16or81leaves. The displayedS follows the naturallogarithm of actualleafcount.
QFEP_E_Term.limit: Branches depict permittedfutures, not their likelihood orsocialaccessibility. An unbuiltbranch and an activelyclosedbranch require differentrecords even if they leave the samecount.
QFEP_E_Term.variation: Existing: attend to a singleend while the fanexpands. Proposed: expose the existing prunedconfiguration, which caps branches and leaves visible stumps, as a visitor-controlledcomparison.
QFEP_E_Term.handoff: Lambda’s hall will turn a balance between repetition and variation into a spatial invitation. Ask what its preferred route leaves to either side.

QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.inherited: From QFEP_E_Term: Lambda’s hall will turn a balance between repetition and variation into a spatial invitation. Ask what its preferred route leaves to either side.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.question: Where does this corridor tell you to stand between stillness and motion?
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.ontology: Lambda is a weightingparameter in theprojectmodel. The hall maps lateralposition to a continuum between two authoredforms oforder anddispersal.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.experiment: Look left toward the regularwall and right toward the displacedmoving forms. Locate the litwalkway and compare the rows between theextremes.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.observe: The westwall repeats a lattice, the eastwall breaks it into animatedforms, and sixrows interpolate between them. The litband is placed at the authoredlambda=.35.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.limit: The litroute makes one choice inviting. That choice is a spatialargument by theproject; the displayed.35 is not a universalcriticalpoint or an empiricaldefinition oflife.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.variation: Existing: inspect the regularside as shelter or the dispersedside as room forvariation instead of accepting the paintedmiddle asbest. Proposed: move thelitband and compare the invitation.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.handoff: Phi introduces time. A system’s present arrangement and its response to change will no longer be the same question.
open_questions: Source-reviewed draft; current museum reach, readable labels, controls and human learning unverified.

QFEP_Phi_Term.inherited: From QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum: Phi introduces time. A system’s present arrangement and its response to change will no longer be the same question.
QFEP_Phi_Term.question: Can change have a direction without one direction being intrinsically better?
QFEP_Phi_Term.ontology: Phi weights thechange term in theprojectformula. Its signedscale is a modelchoice; the neighbouringpattern is an independent illustration of distributedchange.
QFEP_Phi_Term.experiment: Move thePHI handle throughzero and compare its own particlefeedback andcolour. Then watch two differentcells in the transformingpattern and compare theirphases.
QFEP_Phi_Term.observe: Negativephi directs the slider’s particlesdown; positivephi directs themup. Thegold gridcontinues its wave-drivenmotion independently of theslider.
QFEP_Phi_Term.limit: Upwardgold and downwardpurple colour the valuejudgement before anyargument. Welcomingchange may matter, but preservation can also protect what dominantdefinitions erase.
QFEP_Phi_Term.variation: Existing: dwell at neutral ornegativephi and name a kindofchange worthresisting. Proposed: connectphi to a measurabletemporal response and compare with a preservedpattern.
QFEP_Phi_Term.handoff: The next room provides a control connected to a changing pattern. We will keep the parameter, the observed response and the interpretation distinct while comparing them.
open_questions: PHI and the transforming grid run independently. Name one receiving calculation and show the value it actually uses before teaching their causal connection.

QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.inherited: From QFEP_Phi_Term: The next room provides a control connected to a changing pattern. We will keep the parameter, the observed response and the interpretation distinct while comparing them.
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.question: Which changes belong to the pattern, and which to the way we drive it?
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.ontology: This artifact is a two-concentration reaction-diffusion model. Lambda jointly changes feed,kill anddiffusion constants along one authoredpath through itsparameters.
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.experiment: Move LAMBDA slowly, wait for the patternresponse, and use RESEED tocompare a newstart. Keep SIM SPEEDfixed while comparing lambda.
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.observe: A colouredconcentration image changes as reactions andneighbourdiffusion evolve. ChangingLAMBDA affects severalcoefficients atonce; SIM SPEED changes the numberofupdates perframe.
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.limit: A patternlabel is not evidence ofuniversalcriticality. Numericaltimestep, initialconditions and thechosenparameterpath all affectthepicture; apparentactivity can be discretisationartifact.
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.variation: Existing: compare persistence beforeandafterRESEED at the samesliderposition. Proposed: a fixed-timestepcomparison and a measuredpatternstatistic acrosslambda.
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.handoff: The sandbox extends the question of control across several objects. First we must establish which objects actually receive each change.
open_questions: The unlocked field still uses the legacy numerical update. Compare controlled smaller timesteps from the same initial field before claiming stable regimes or criticality.

QFEP_Sandbox.inherited: From QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos: The sandbox extends the question of control across several objects. First we must establish which objects actually receive each change.
QFEP_Sandbox.question: How do we tell a control that changes a number from one that changes a system?
QFEP_Sandbox.ontology: A control, parameter and response form a causalchain only when the receiving system uses the newvalue. Shared vocabulary and proximity do not establish thatconnection.
QFEP_Sandbox.experiment: Move onehandle at atime, record its own printedvalue/colour, and compare the localfeedback ofLAMBDA with PHI. Keep the otherhandle fixed.
QFEP_Sandbox.observe: LAMBDA reads0–1 and changes itslocalcolour/feedback; PHI reads−1–1 and reverses itslocalparticle direction acrosszero. The nearbyreactor/particlefield are not proven totrack eithercontrol.
QFEP_Sandbox.limit: The intended coupled sandbox has a wiringgap. A correctprinted setting alone cannotdemonstrate a change in a distantartifact or let thisroom certify theformula.
QFEP_Sandbox.variation: Proposed nextbuild: explicitlywire bothcontrols to one scopedreceiver, expose receivedvalues and compare oneparameter at atime. Presentcontrolobservations are a startingpoint, not fulfilment ofthatexperiment.
QFEP_Sandbox.handoff: The synthesis specimen supplies a smaller completed connection: its own two controls alter the mechanics of one body.
open_questions: The controls and receivers search different groups. Wire one room-scoped receiver, display its actual inputs and repeat one change at a time.

QFEP_Synthesis.inherited: From QFEP_Sandbox: The synthesis specimen supplies a smaller completed connection: its own two controls alter the mechanics of one body.
QFEP_Synthesis.question: Which kind of stability are you asking this body to keep?
QFEP_Synthesis.ontology: The specimen interprets two projectparameters through softbodyproperties: lambdaaffects stiffness/pressure; phiaffects damping/drag. These are authoredmappings between vocabulary andmechanics.
QFEP_Synthesis.experiment: Use the specimen’s own LAMBDA andPHI sliders. Holdone fixed while movingtheother; compare how shape,motion andreadoutrespond.
QFEP_Synthesis.observe: Lambda shifts stiffness andcolour whilephi shifts thedampinganddrag of thespecimen. Namedstates onthelabel are assignedfrom parameterbands.
QFEP_Synthesis.limit: A visiblebodyresponding to mechanics is not an assay ofqueerness or alivingstate. The sameword phi had a differentscale on the firstconsole; consistentmeaning requires naming eachmapping.
QFEP_Synthesis.variation: Existing: combine highstiffness with lowdamping, or lowstiffness with highdamping, instead ofchoosing only namedpresets. Proposed: keep one measurabledeformation trace as acomparison.
QFEP_Synthesis.handoff: Post-crisis begins with representation itself. After learning to name a model’s choices, ask whose distinctions those choices make clear and whose they compress.
open_questions: Check the specimen's quarter-scale controls for legibility and reach before treating the written slider comparison as available to every visitor.
